title: Nightmare Night 2026
desc: Enter a free community game filled with creature hunting, special abilities, bosses, achievements, and faction battles! Team up with other players, explore a strange new world, and compete for your side. It’s completely free to play, with free prizes and rewards to earn throughout the event! While the event is a pony community, all types of avatars are accepted! The event runs from October 1st-31st.

title: SPOOKTOBER v2 - Freaky Carnival
desc: Spooktober V2 brings a creepy carnival to the Bellisseria Fairgrounds from October 1 through 31. Visitors can wander the freak-show midway, explore eerie attractions and carnival oddities, and join DJ parties every weekend, with Halloween festivities continuing through October 31.

title: Halloween Shop & Hop - Jubilant
desc: Enjoy the 2026 Halloween Shop and Hop featuring 380 of your favorite creators bringing their spooktacular best, from costumes to decor and everything in between! The event will run from October 2nd through November 1st. A full list of all participating creators with their exact slurls can be found here: second.life/halloween2026

title: Haunted Terror Town Hunt
desc: Dare to Dream, home of Dream Stars and Dream Kids, and Whispering Event present Haunted Terror Town Hunt, featuring a region filled with hunts, mazes, hauntings, and entertainment. Open October 1 through November 1.

title: Ravens Hollow Returns 2026
desc: Did you survive last year’s terrifying journey into the unknown? Ravens Hollow Returns with an all-new immersive, HUD-driven Halloween game. Dark secrets, new horrors, and a story waiting to be uncovered. This October, your adventure awaits!

title: Wild Pack's Halloween Adventure
desc: Somehow you have ended up at the Last Stop just outside the Pearly Gates. Although it is not your time, here you are. Might as well make the best of it and enjoy the all-new Temple of Terror Tour, the Haunted Swamp Tour, as well as Silent City and The Cursed Circus, boasting 31 rides and many games to play.

title: MadPea Fortune Fishing
desc: Join MadPea's Fortune Fishing - Starlit Secrets Season from September through November 2026. Grab your Bait and fish beneath the stars for prizes, Fortune Points, rare Fortune Coins, and elusive Legendary catches. Level up, unlock magical rods, chase achievements, and climb the seasonal leaderboard! Fish daily. Trade your treasures. Cast far. Dream big.

title: Salem Event 2026
desc: Inspired by the shadowed history and folklore of the 1692 witch trials, Salem brings together more than 100 creators for a sweeping and spellbinding shopping experience. Just in time for Halloween, visitors can explore new and exclusive releases for the season, all within a rich landscape steeped in mystery and autumnal darkness. Salem is open from October 1st through 31st.

title: The Fright Room
desc: The Fright Room is where Halloween has taken over The Fitting Room in the best possible way. Explore a creepy haunted house, wander through a twisted, ghoulish circus, and brave a collection of spooky rides, eerie attractions, and unsettling surprises!

title: Haunting Labyrinth
desc: Haunting Labyrinth is a two-region Halloween maze filled with scares, surprises, shopping, and creations from over 200 designers. Pick up a Hunt HUD and search the maze for hidden pumpkin prizes priced from L$0–L$25. The event is presented by Difony Events and is open from October 1–31.

title: Halloweentown
desc: Step into Halloweentown’s 17th year and explore a completely redesigned world of haunted attractions, eerie carnival grounds, interactive scares, hidden surprises, and Halloween shopping. For the full experience, accept Experience permissions, use Shared Environment, and keep Second Life sounds enabled.

title: Sci-Fi Mini Fair 2026
desc: Sci-Fi Fairland hosts the Sci-Fi Mini Fair 2026 for three full months, from October 1 through December 31. Visitors can explore creators, vendors, themed activities, surprises, and community events while supporting the American Cancer Society’s Relay For Life, with 100% of proceeds benefiting the cause.

title: MadPea Shadow Seekers: The Ghost Files
desc: MadPea Shadow Seekers - The Ghost Files is a paranormal grid-wide adventure running from October 3rd - November 1st. As a Shadow Seeker, you'll track supernatural manifestations across the grid, earn Shadow Points, and rise through the ranks to unlock classified Ghost Files: terrifying cases where the spirits are very real, highly aggressive, and deadly. Your mission is simple: Find the haunting. Photograph the ghost. Survive.

title: Halloween Swaginator Hunt
desc: Linden Lab's Halloween Swaginator Hunt is back! Start at the spooky Millbank region, touch to receive the Halloween Swaginator HUD, right-click and add it from your inventory, and then dive into a thrilling adventure as you search for hidden treasures and exclusive Halloween-themed prizes. Explore eerie locations, solve mysterious clues, and enjoy the festive atmosphere. Don’t miss out on this exciting quest to celebrate the Halloween season!

title: It’s The Great Trick-or-Treat Event, Bellisseria!
desc: Creep or crawl over to Bellisseria this Halloween season to snag some candy and win prizes! This is an interactive event open to *everyone* where Residents living in Bellisseria can host Candy Buckets on their parcels. You don’t want to miss the paranormal partygoers and creative costumes throughout Bellisseria during this virtual Trick-or-Treat. Head over, pick up a HUD, and start trick-or-treating!

title: WIRED Art Installation by eta and Jos
desc: WIRED is an immersive art installation by eta and Jos, built from sculptural geometry, shifting light, and photographic art drawn from real life. Visitors explore a layered environment where the atmosphere changes through a tablet‑based windlight menu, and sculpt elements invite interaction — some playful pieces can be knocked down, while others stand as fixed forms within the space.

title: Engine Room
desc: Engine Room is an historically inspired fantasy and science fiction expo featuring steampunk, dieselpunk, aetherpunk, historical, and various styles for roleplay and more! The event location is designed by Walton Wainwright and runs from September 20th through October 20th.

title: Halloween at Icewater Village
desc: Halloween has arrived in Icewater Village! Explore the abandoned house, the spooky Mannequin Doll House, wander through the haunted cemetery, or enjoy some sinister shopping. From October 7th to 31st, take part in the Halloween Haunted Hunt—based on different true mystery stories. Are you brave enough?

title: Spooktakulum 2026
desc: Long Beach invites you to a new shopping and treasure hunting adventure, even some treasures with trivia. Many creative accessories, decorations, plants, and outfits await you, even for Dinkies. The destination also features broomstick and carousel rides, and nice spots for taking pictures. The event runs between October 1st and 31st. Come enjoy!

title: The Last Stream
desc: DRD presents The Last Stream, an immersive Halloween hunt and story experience set in Hollowbrook. Follow the final broadcast of five streamers, solve puzzles, uncover secrets and achievements, and collect prizes while discovering what happened to them. Full information is at www.deathrowdesigns.net/hunt

title: SLs Top Haunted Places Tour & Hunt
desc: It is the 17th year of SL's Top Haunted Places Tour & Hunt! Enjoy one month of approximately 100 kinds of haunted places, hunts, and shopping! Can you make it through all of them? Wear your costumes and fit right in. Get your list from the sign, which is updated all month long, so check back often. The event runs from October 1st to 31st.

title: SHADOWFELL'S CIRCLE OF LIGHT
desc: Beyond the ruins of the ancient Elven city lies a meadow where the last light of magic still battles the darkness. At its heart, the Circle of Light glows upon enchanted waters, holding the darkness at bay. Relax among plentiful seating, enjoy quiet moments alone, or cuddle with someone special. Experience music, choreographed dance events and spectacular particle light shows beneath Shadowfell’s magic.

title: Khargo Halloween
desc: Khargo Halloween is the destination for spooky, creepy, quirky, and fun Halloween home and yard decor in Second Life! Whether you're creating a haunted house, creepy graveyard, spooky beach, or decorating your home and yard, Khargo Halloween has the decorations you'll need to help bring your Halloween vision to life. Decorations range from frightening and eerie to whimsical and downright funny. Keeping SL spooky since 2009!

title: The Collab Circle
desc: The Collab Circle is a monthly themed shopping event featuring exclusive releases from talented creators in an immersive destination. From September 30 through October 21, experience the Electric 80s theme, collect an exclusive gift at each participating creator stall for Premium and Premium Plus members, and discover fashion, beauty, skins, accessories, hair, poses, and more.

title: Pumpkin Palooza
desc: Pumpkin Palooza celebrates its third year with spooky, family-friendly fun. Knock on doors to collect 14 free tricks or treats, then explore the town in search of over 250 hidden candy apples filled with creations from participating stores. Visitors will also find photo opportunities throughout the event.

title: County Fair Hay Maze
desc: Step right up and get lost in the County Fair Hay Maze! Wander through winding walls of hay bales surrounded by towering cornstalks, cheerful pumpkins, colorful autumn leaves, and festive fairground decorations. Around every corner, you might discover a surprise, a silly scare, or the perfect spot for a fall photo. Remember to pick up your holiday plushie!

title: Great Halloween Scavenger Hunt
desc: The Great Halloween Scavenger Hunt at Caledon Rose offers spooky fun for everyone, with no gore or horror. Free to play with no HUDs, the notecard-based hunt features five levels from Easy to Impossible. Can you find all the items? You’re double dog dared to try! The hunt runs from September 26 through November 10.

title: LTD Harvest & Home Autumn Market
desc: Welcome autumn with Love to Decorate at The Harvest & Home Autumn Market, a vintage-inspired outdoor market celebrating the colors, character, and warmth of the season. Wander through a beautifully styled autumn setting filled with cozy market spaces, seasonal details, and new creations and gifts from more than 30 Second Life home, garden, décor, and lifestyle designers. Discover rustic furnishings, garden pieces, seasonal décor, atmospheric accents, and plenty of unexpected finds while exploring a market designed to feel as much like an autumn destination as a shopping event. The market is open from September 19 through October 11.

title: Boogeyman's
desc: Boogeyman's on the region of Amainiris is creepy all year-round! Explore the vast, dark forest, check in at the asylum, don't go down the hole, and don't go in the water! So much to see and take in. Use the shared environment, turn up the sound, and turn down the music.

title: Kickers Creek Fall Festival
desc: Step into Kickers Creek, a charming little community where there is small-town warmth that has been transformed into fall! The community comes alive with fall colors, pumpkin picking and carving, a scavenger hunt, and plenty more! Whether you're stopping by for a visit, looking for a place to call home, or simply looking for something fun to do, there is always something happening around Kickers.

title: RGF - Pumpkin Pie: Fall Seasonal Rentals
desc: Welcome to RGF Estates - Pumpkin Pie! Explore this autumn-themed region featuring seasonal home and parcel rentals, scenic views, haunted houses, and a sleepy little town. Enjoy the fall atmosphere and find a cozy place to call home! Open October 8 through December 7, 2026. This is a limited-time seasonal region, so enjoy it while it lasts. All parcels, cabins, and region items will be returned after December 7.

title: The SWAMP
desc: The mud surrounds, hides, slows you down. The water holds what the earth can no longer contain. Images surface without ever fully emerging. Crumpled, wet, exposed. Like thoughts that have remained too long beneath the surface. Walk through the swamp, observe, ask questions, and then let your whole being flow without sinking.

title: Varna after Dark: a Halloween nightmare
desc: Varna After Dark transforms a rain-soaked city into a Halloween nightmare. Beyond the dark city streets, horror waits: an alien invasion, a sinister circus, a haunted cemetery, ghost-filled witch houses, and surreal creatures. An atmospheric dark-fantasy destination created for exploration, photography, and those drawn to the strange.

title: The Hex Sanctuarium
desc: Welcome to The Hex Sanctuarium. Explore an abandoned Vermont psychiatric institution and the forgotten Von Hex Manor, where decades of secrets remain buried. Search for evidence, examine old records, and follow the stories of multiple victims

title: Park Plaza Pumpkin Patch
desc: Park Plaza Pumpkin Patch is a family-friendly seasonal pop-up open October 1st through the 31st, offering pick-your-own pumpkins, cozy hot cider, and themed photo spots that welcome visitors to wander the patch, take photos, and enjoy small-town autumn fun.

title: Warblood City Autumn Carnival
desc: Warblood City's Annual Autumn Carnival returns with rides, games, food, spooky fun, Kiddie Land, and plenty of autumn mischief. Organized by the Warblood City Cancer Kickers, the event supports the American Cancer Society. Free entry for all ages from September 21 through November 1, 2026.

title: Progeny Presents Terror Town
desc: Progeny presents Terror Town, a Halloween experience where vampires and therians are ready to scare visitors with rides, trick-or-treating, and 100 gifts to find. Open October 1 through November 1.

title: Eclipse - All Hallows' Gala
desc: Step beyond the veil and enter Eclipse – All Hallows’ Gala, where elegance and the supernatural intertwine for a Halloween experience unlike any other. Wander through hauntingly beautiful spaces, uncover dark surprises, indulge in immersive experiences, and discover what awaits around every shadowed corner. Murder Mystery and Paid experience options are also available! The All Hallows' Gala event takes place from October 1st through November 1st. Info at the landing point!

title: Ghoster Coaster Ride
desc: Climb aboard the Ghoster Coaster for a frightfully fun ride through a haunted Halloween night! Twist, turn, climb, and plunge past restless ghosts, creepy surprises, and things that go bump in the dark. Keep your hands inside the car and your courage close as you race through this spirited adventure. It’s spooky, silly, and just scary enough to make you scream!

title: Fort Blood
desc: The SLRandom Artcrew presents Fort Blood, a haunted pirate attraction blending a boat ride with interactive adventure. Board the boat, soak up the atmosphere, or step ashore and explore if you dare. With secrets to discover and trouble lurking nearby, this Halloween voyage offers more than a quiet trip on the water.

title: All Hallows Eve at Paradise Mountains
desc: All Hallows Eve at Paradise Mountains runs from September 15 through October 31. Brave visitors can enter Room 7 to be transported to the main haunt, where clues lead to 25 gifts. Visitors can find more than 40 gifts in total, including hidden bonus gifts, and can also join contests to win L$.

title: YOKAI ISLAND
desc: To survive the hurricane, your ship sought refuge in the center of a group of islands, hoping to be protected. Your ship is attacked by Akkorokamui, a giant octopus. You wash ashore and discover this island is unlike anything you have ever seen. Is it cursed, have you entered the underworld, or is it something completely different? Come explore Yokai Island for Halloween.

title: Fairywood Fete
desc: Wander into Fairywood Fête at Stardust Hallow, an enchanted forest filled with towering mushrooms, curious creatures, hidden paths and magical secrets waiting to be discovered. Join the fête September 19th sponsored by Raindale & Sekai and explore the Fairywood Fête Market through October 19th. Come get lost in a little magic.

title: Second Life Cinema
desc: Experience the magic of machinima at the Second Life Cinema! With regular events and an ever-changing roster of videos, it's a must-visit for film enthusiasts in Second Life. Remember to enable your media, turn up the volume under Sound & Media Preferences, and toggle the play/pause button to watch the movies here. Currently playing SL Video Creators Group's Director Showcase of SueSue Sideways.

title: The Velvet
desc: Since 2006, the Velvet's been rocking the grid with some of the finest indie and alternative music. The Velvet is home to some of SL's most passionate DJs, and they take pride in sharing music collections with an ever-appreciative crowd. From October 17th-18th, they will be celebrating their 20th anniversary with a full weekend of events. Join the celebration!
